   ```rust
   assert_eq!(redraw.state.latest_status, NarrativeStatus::Fresh);
   assert_eq!(redraw.snapshot.status, NarrativeStatus::Fresh);
   assert!(
       narrative_plain_lines(&redraw, NarrativeVisualMode::None)
           .join("\n")
           .contains("freshness: fresh via provider")
   );
   ```
   This closes the “call counts survive deterministic redraws” gap for unchanged coverage.
